snippet.title: Hanafuda Graffiti - Koi-Koi Monogatari (花札グラフィティー 恋々物語): Story Mode Full Playthrough
snippet.description:
Whenever arriving at one place, someone (from those who were introduced in the beginning of the game) may have a chance to either greet you or offer you a practice match. However, as I tried to finish the game as quickly as possible, I always declined their offers because they are not mandatory to continue the game. Nevertheless, there are a total of 17 mandatory battles in order to finish the game.

Because one normal game of Hanafuda consists of multiple rounds (six, twelve, or winning by points depending on the setting), starting from the second game (against Yuka) I sped up the video during all rounds but the last one when I won the game, because the card game is pretty much the same so showing all rounds are not necessary. Doing this reduced the video's length by about one hour (the original recording of this video was 2 hours 42 minutes).
